definition: Every direct visual image-tool observation counts as an image open. Byte hashing and PNG-header dimension reads are nonvisual. Exactly the four authorized original screenshots were opened, once each, in the order below. No source scan, other image, crop, reopen, browser capture or image payload returned to the parent.

entries.observed_extent: Entire original full-page screenshot: complete numbered Chinese title, printed-page metadata, all nine reading paragraphs, both horizontal concept separators, bold electron-cloud term, inline circled footnote marker, parenthesized 11.8, complete closing footnote paragraph, zero-count exercise footer, both margins and bottom whitespace.

Entire original full-page screenshot: complete one-line English title, printed-page metadata, every line of all nine reading paragraphs, both horizontal concept separators, serif prose and bold electron cloud, inline circled marker, readable 11.8 reference wrapping to its own line, complete closing footnote paragraph, zero-count exercise footer and bottom whitespace.

Entire original full-page screenshot: complete two-line Chinese title including its final character on the second line, printed-page metadata, every wrapped line of all nine reading paragraphs, two separators, bold electron-cloud term, circled footnote markers, parenthesized 11.8, complete footnote through the final sentence, zero-count exercise footer, both gutters and bottom whitespace.

Entire original full-page screenshot: complete two-line English title, printed-page metadata, every wrapped line of all nine reading paragraphs through the final visible-object footnote sentence, two separators, serif prose and bold electron cloud, circled markers, clearly readable radius in (11.8), zero-count exercise footer, both gutters and bottom whitespace.
